claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the pleasant minty scent that isn't overpowering.
Many customers chose this as a talc-free alternative and report it works well as a replacement.
Several reviewers find it effective at absorbing moisture and keeping skin dry, though a few note it isn't as long-lasting as traditional powders.
Some reviewers mention the price is higher than competitors like Gold Bond, though most still consider it worth it.
Users appreciate the cooling sensation, especially in hot climates and for hot flashes.
